verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury is a SaaS financial-services platform that processes customer and transaction data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, data-usage controls, or any training-data policy. The docs cover financial accounts, money movement, and fraud controls, and the community items concern competitors and a bank hack, none of which address this story.
